svg.title: AlexNet
svg.desc: Original conceptual schematic. Five convolutional layers and three fully connected layers; ReLU, selected max-pooling, dropout. Not a reproduction of a paper figure. MIT.

g.text: Five convolutional layers followed by three fully connected layers
ReLU activations · local response normalization in early layers · dropout in the classifier
Concept schematic · implementation details omitted · original artwork / MIT
